# Spelling list: CLIENT NAME

Check every transcript against this list before cutting. Whisper mishears names, and captions must be exact.

| Correct | Common mishears | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Full Name | Wrong Name, Other Wrong | person |
| Brand Name (BRN) | Brand Aim | say it as "B-R-N" on screen? |
| Product™ | Product | keep the ™ in captions |
